Three turn up in Op.12..."- Nice, ''Prokofiev: From Russia to the West, 1891-1935'', p.50. *Grove Music does not list an arrangement by Prokofiev of No.7 for harp, though it does list the 4-bassoon arrangement of No.9 as op.12bis. Thus, it is unknown who did this arrangement.
